text:
sam: quick heads-up — I'm doing a pass on the audit log docs for SOC2 language. Found a few spots where we say 'retain for X' that might read as policy rather than configurable settings. opening PR shortly.
priya: thanks. we should also make sure the examples show both console and SDK flows; some customers only use the SDK.
alex: agreed. i'll add a minimal Go snippet as well — we have TS and Python already in other pages.
legal-ops: FYI: avoid absolutes like 'we purge' or 'we delete on' — prefer 'retained per configured retention windows' and show options for export/legal-hold.
docs-bot: :warning: lint: heading-conventions, :white_check_mark: link-checker.
sam: will rename a heading and push. also added a tiny migration checklist for Dedicated -> Private: snapshot exports, rotate/confirm KMS, confirm network egress rules, validate ingestion into private store.
priya: can we add a note about export artifact format (JSONL) and the 'redwood_audit_version' field? helps partner ingestion.
sam: added note and small example of a JSONL line.
legal-ops: add a short pseudonymization snippet showing hashing tenant id (sha256) and link to privacy playbook.
priya: small nit — use 'destination' as the param name in SDK examples not 'dest_uri'.
sam: done. re-run checks.
docs-bot: :white_check_mark: all checks passed.
priya: lgtm.
legal-ops: approving wording.
sam: merged. will add the PR number to the evidence pack.
